title: Mixed Event — KAMIYAMA HIGH FESTIVAL!

meta.Outline: It's the day of the Kamiyama High School Festival, which had completely slipped Mizuki's mind. Upon An's invitation, Mizuki decides to check it out and makes several interesting encounters, including one with a familiar face. Together, they reminisce on the last time they met...

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nngh... Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What time is it...? Eight?
Huh, I woke up earlier than usual.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I finished work early last night, and then...
Oh, right... I passed out at my desk.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Great, I've got ink stains on my cheek from my notes. What a crummy way to start a new day...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Who's calling me this early? Oh, it's An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Hey, Mizuki! How's it going?
Are you coming to school today?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
School?
But it's Saturday, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <I knew it... You forgot.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Forgot about what?
Is something going on today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <The School Festival is today!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah...
I forgot all about it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Haha! Classic Mizuki...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Our class just finished setting up, so I'm just wandering around. You wanna come? There are food stalls and all sorts of other stuff to do.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm, I guess I could...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, but...)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Is that the person you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: I was just a little curious about why you dress the way you do.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't really want that kind of attention...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I feel bad about disappointing An, but I think I'll pass...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Oh, and lots of students are wearing funky outfits today. A lot of the second years are in costume for their class shows too. It's really cool!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Unless you wear something really crazy, it's gonna be hard to stand out in this crowd.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That's considerate of her, telling me in an indirect way that it's safe for me to come.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can't really come up with any excuse not to go now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'll head over then!
Can't wait to see all those costumes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Great! I'm working my stall until noon, so you can find me in our classroom!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Got it. See you soon, and thanks for the invite.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The School Festival, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I haven't been to one since...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yikes, I can't be spacing out now or I'll be late.
I better get ready to go...!
Kamiyama High School - School Festival Day

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There you are, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What are you wearing...?
Is that a new T-shirt?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, it's our class uniform for the day!
We designed it together, so we're all wearing one.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
There's one for you too.
Want me to go get it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, I'm good...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There are too many people around to find a private place to get changed anyways...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
Well, it's your choice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I just finished up so let's check out the festival!
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow, this place is packed!
And there are lots of stalls like you said!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! Our School Festival attracts a lot of the local residents too, see?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Look, they're selling cotton candy over there.
It looks so cute! Let's get some!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Phew! That was a lot of stalls.
I feel like I'm gonna pop.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Same here.
Wanna go back to the classroom?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hey, An...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, you made it! You said you weren't sure if you could come, so I'd almost given up hope!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't know if I'd have time, but I finished up earlier than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you must be Azusawa.
An's always talking about you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right, she's my unbeatable singing partner♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
H-Hello there!
I'm Kohane Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm Mizuki Akiyama.
It's really nice to meet you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um. Nice to meet you too...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, how about we check stuff out all together?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A-All of us...?!
Oh... Um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Is she getting nervous because I'm here?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She came all this way on her own, so she probably wants to hang out with An.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (In that case...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, drat! The teacher noticed me. Ever since I missed that test, she's been all over me about taking a make-up...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You two go on ahead. I need to find some place to hide. I'll see you later, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what? Mizuki?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shoot, they're gone...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Looks like they're not following me.
I might as well look around on my own then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Every class seems to be showcasing something different. There are theater performances, movie-inspired shows... What should I see first?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Although...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Everyone's wearing their class festival T-shirt.
I'm gonna stick out like a sore thumb...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not like that's different from any other day...
Ha ha ha ha ha!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What the...?!
Was someone laughing?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It sounded like it was coming from the empty classroom upstairs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess I don't have anything better to do. Let's go see what's going on...
Kamiyama High School - Classroom

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Tsukasa, shall we rehearse the proposal scene again?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It's a pivotal point of the play, so we need to get this part just right.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right! Perfectionism is the mark of a true star after all!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay. I'll be your partner for this scene.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Kneel down while holding the sword in your right hand behind you and your left hand raised imploringly.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Good, just like that.
Now say your lines.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: O Juliet! Sun of my life! I beg of you, allow me your fair hand in marriage!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Romeo...  Then refuse thy name and I shall swear my love!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sweet Juliet...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That was great! I think you're ready for the show.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thanks for your help, guys! I'm going to stir up a whirlpool of emotions in the hearts of the students here... No, in the hearts of the whole world!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think you're a little out of touch with reality...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh yeah? What makes you say that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I gave the script a read thinking a parody of Romeo and Juliet might be fun, but all you've got here is a bunch of fight scenes and weird plot twists.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How can anyone feel moved by this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You just don't get it! Seeing nine Romeos battling it out to the death to prove their love is going to be a gripping spectacle!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I love that scene too. Desperate to win the heart of their beloved Juliet, the Romeos mercilessly slaughter each other one after another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Blood gushes left and right to the accompaniment of agonized screams. And yet, the audience is unable to contain their laughter.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think it's wonderful that you've made a comedy out of this tragic story about a fatal fight for love.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? But I wrote this as a tragedy, not a comedy...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hahaha...!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, I didn't realize it was so late...
I need to go help out at the class stall.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Your show starts soon. Shouldn't you get ready?
Even if we're not in it, our reputations are on the line as well, so try not to totally mess things up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! My performances are always top quality!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's just Nene's way of saying she cares, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think this is the classroom where that weird laughter was coming from.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, wait... Is that Rui?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(The others must be his classmates.
They seem like they're having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Rui's expression seems a lot softer than it used to be...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, I get it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (He's managed to make some good friends.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe I should leave them be...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This class is doing a haunted house!
The decorations are really good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I bet it would give Ena the creeps. Mafuyu doesn't seem the type to get spooked by this sort of stuff though.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (As for Kanade, I wonder... I kind of want to see what she's like when something startles her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Wait a minute, why am I thinking about them right now?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Maybe deep down, I'm just craving company...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It'd be fun to have Ena here... But with her taking night classes and all, I bet she couldn't be bothered...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I could call Kanade or Mafuyu, but I can't really picture them being very enthusiastic about it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wonder what it would be like for all of N25 to go to a School Festival together...)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Shinonome, don't forget your shift starts at three.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No worries, I'll be back in time.
See you then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It couldn't be...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's fine. I just got here too.
What's your class's theme? A haunted house?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah. But I'm just the receptionist.
What's your job for today...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Selling cotton candy. It's not just regular cotton candy, but really fancy ones. Making them is actually more fun than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, right. You sent me a picture earlier.
But I still can't imagine you making them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, Akito. There's something I wanted to see today. Want to come along?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which thing? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(That guy's name is Akito Shinonome...
That has to mean...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I may be wrong, but I'm gonna say hello!
He gives off the same sort of vibe too so!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, you there!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Your name is Akito Shinonome, right? Any chance you're Ena's little brother?
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, Ena's my sister...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?! I knew it!
So you're a student here too?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And based on the fact that you're in the class doing the haunted house, you must be the same year as me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I had no idea we were the same age.
Ena should've told me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, but who are you...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm Mizuki Akiyama from Class 1-A.
Ena and I are... Close friends, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, and what's your name?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Toya Aoyagi, Class 1-B.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Toya, got it!
Nice to meet the both of you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyhow, Li'l Bro, is Ena here today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Li'l Bro...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sigh... I have no idea what my sister is up to.
She's probably still sleeping as usual.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aw, I knew it.
I thought we could hang out if she was here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh well. I'll just enjoy the festival on my own.
Is there anything worth seeing in the gym?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It was Akiyama, right?
You're welcome to join us if you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Akito & Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My friend's play is starting soon, so I was going to head that way. How would you like to come along?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, is that what you were talking about earlier?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is this friend you're talking about that Tsukasa guy you introduced me to before?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah. He even wrote the script himself and he's playing the lead.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh, that sounds cool! I don't get to see plays often, so it'll be a treat!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, if you really don't mind having me around that is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The more people that come to see Tsukasa's performance, the better. You coming, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Fine, whatever...
So he's actually gonna perform, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Li'l Bro! Toya! What are we still doing here? Let's go ♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't pull...! And knock it off with the Li'l Bro stuff, will you... Whoa!
Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow! They've got a big audience!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No doubt they're all here to see Tsukasa's performance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sure about that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
The play's called Romeo: Battle Royale...
It sounds like a B-list movie...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't judge a book by its cover.
Oh, we can snag the front seats too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Exactly my thinking. This way, we'll get the best view of Tsukasa in action.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You actually seem excited, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do I?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate
rows.Line: Attention, please. The performance will begin shortly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate
rows.Line: Please be aware this play features battle scenes. We would like to ask those sitting in the front row to be careful.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What kind of battle scenes do you think they're doing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but if they involve Tsukasa, they're guaranteed to be unbelievable.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not necessarily in a good way...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate
rows.Line: We now present to you... Romeo: Battle Royale!

rows.Speaker: Sickle and Chain Romeo
rows.Line:
I am Sickle and Chain Romeo!!
I've come to end you... Hyaaaaargh!!

rows.Speaker: Morning Star Romeo
rows.Line:
Morning Star Romeo is my name!!
No other Romeo stands a chance... Aaargh!!

rows.Speaker: Swordmaster Romeo
rows.Line: Hmph! Weaklings! I am the most powerful of all, for they call me Swordmaster Romeo! You pathetic worms don't deserve to bear the same name as I!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahahaha! What's going on here?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not a clue...

rows.Speaker: Swordmaster Romeo
rows.Line: If only you trained for a hundred million light years more, you may've been a worthy rival. Alas, I shall erase you from existence here and now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, aren't light years a unit of distance?
Did he make a mistake?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't think so. If Tsukasa put that in the script, it must have some deeper meaning.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I really doubt that...

rows.Speaker: Swordmaster Romeo
rows.Line: I shall defeat every last one of you and win the heart of my beloved Juliet!

rows.Speaker: Swordmaster Romeo
rows.Line: Ha ha ha ha ha!
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man, that made my head hurt...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whew! I'm tired from laughing so much!
That play was so crazy, it was surreal!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I got that a bunch of Romeos would battle it out until only one remained, but I didn't expect the last one to go into space and become some cosmic entity.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Toya, you said your friend was the lead?
He's definitely got a pretty wild persona...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was an exceptionally profound performance...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It may have seemed a farce on the surface, but it was underpinned by philosophical questions. I sense some hidden meaning in the music that played during the final scene as well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do you think Toya is under some really powerful hypnosis or something...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see where you're coming from... But I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
While we're on this topic, I've got a question.
Why do you look up to him so much?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I remember you saying that you owe him a great deal or something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
I never told you the details, did I?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You see, I owe him a debt of gratitude.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Our parents knew each other, so Tsukasa and I used to play together when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then you two go way back...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And as you already know, Akito, my dad was teaching me classical music since I was only a few years old.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, he was extremely strict...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He made me practice before going to school and after coming home until it was time for bed. On weekends, I had to spend the entire day playing the piano and violin.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the time I started middle school, I couldn't stand it anymore. I started thinking about finding a way out...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That sounds tough. I can only imagine...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I couldn't bring myself to disappoint my dad like that after how much time and effort he'd put into nurturing me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's when Tsukasa said something that changed everything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's your life, so you should live it your way.
If you don't like it, then just say so!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He said that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Those words are what finally helped me make up my mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's thanks to Tsukasa that I gave up classical music and became friends with Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If it weren't for him, I wouldn't be who I am today. He changed my life, and that's why I owe him this debt...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now I get it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess that means I should be grateful too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (He's grateful to the person who helped him change, huh?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I owe someone that same debt too then...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I should go and let Tsukasa know what I thought about the play.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Should we go back in then? It looks like they're done cleaning up, so you should be able to talk to him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I leave the rest to you!
I'm sorry but I must go now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate
rows.Line: No problem, Tenma. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Toya!
Thanks for coming to the show!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Your play was great.
I particularly enjoyed...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sorry, but I've gotta run...!
We'll talk later, okay? See ya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aaand he's gone. Maybe he had to hurry off to another show or something?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I really wanted to share my feedback with him while it was fresh in my mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I could try giving him a call...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Darn, it went straight to voicemail...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll run into him again if we just keep looking around. Considering how loud he is, it'd be hard to miss him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You're right.
Sorry for dragging you along, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But he sure disappeared quick...
Where do we even start?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Want me to help out too?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really? You don't have to feel obligated to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha, don't worry about it. I want to check out the rest of the festival anyway, so I can kill two birds with one stone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Besides, I want to do something in return for inviting me along to see that hilarious play.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, I'll appreciate your help...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, then let's split up. If I find Tsukasa first, I'll tell him to give you a call ASAP!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll see you later, guys!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, hold on! Akiyama!
At least give us your number or some...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sheesh. Everyone's all over the place today...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, does the name Akiyama ring a bell to you? Wasn't there some rumor about them going around a while ago?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, whatever... Let's start looking for your friend, Toya.
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Tsukasaaa!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No luck here either... Hm? What's this?

rows.Speaker: Gaming Tournament Host
rows.Line: And the winner of the Kamiyama Gaming Tournament is... Nene Kusanagi! Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Gaming Tournament Host
rows.Line: Her incredible high score left the contestants in the dust! Could we please have a few words, Ms. Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I, um... I'm... I'm very happy. Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Gaming Tournament Host
rows.Line: Your score in the shooting game category deserves a special mention! Could you give us some tips on how to get better at shooters?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I, um... I just play a lot at home...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, I think I've heard of that shooter.
Isn't it supposed to be super hard?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
She must be amazing.
Maybe I should get that game too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, I'm already getting distracted!
Tsukasa! Where's Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ugh, I'm not making any progress. Plenty of people have seen him, but too many witnesses can be as bad as none.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, look. It's Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: It's been ages! I didn't think you'd show up!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: You know, if Mizuki doesn't like people pointing it out, why not just dress normally for school?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I know, right? Of course people are going to say things when you stand out like that.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: That's just the way Mizuki is, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Totally. Some people just don't know how to blend in.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, good to see you again! The festival seemed fun, so I thought I'd check it out♪

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: But... Why aren't you wearing the class T-shirt?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well... I was offered one but getting changed seemed like too much of a bother, so I figured I'd pass.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hm. Yeah, I see your point. I guess wearing the same T-shirt as everyone else in your class is pretty cliche and uncool.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah! It's a class event so I put mine on too, but it makes me kinda cringe.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, do you want to check out the festival with us? It's been so long since we got to chat.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, but I'm actually looking for someone right now.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, okay. That's too bad.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You guys have fun, though!
See ya!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wearing the same outfit is uncool, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You can only say that because you actually fit in.
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Wow!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You were right. You can see the entire festival from up here. Thank you for showing me, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe, it's my pleasure.
It's nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But are you sure you wouldn't rather be with your classmates than on the rooftop with me?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Absolutely. I'm done with all I had to do anyway.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I love festivals like this, but my classmates always shoot down my ideas because they're too extreme.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Compatibility is really important when working on a project with other people. Which is sort of why I've always been an outcast.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, no need to pity me. I finally managed to find some like-minded friends so...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You mean Tsukasa, Nene and Emu?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I'm happy for you.
We all love seeing you smile.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, KAITO. But to be honest, I never expected things to get better for me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought the only way to put on my shows was to do everything on my own.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought it would be enough as long as others were able to enjoy them, even if I had no friends.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the shows I really wanted to do couldn't be done with just one person...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hm? It sounds like someone's coming up the stairs...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh...
Another friend of mine.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <A friend?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You could say we're kindred spirits.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you mind if I chat with them for a bit...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Not at all. Take your time. I was thinking of heading back anyway. See you later, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Until our next show, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Who's there? Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello, Mizuki. It's been a while since we last met up here.
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What are you doing up here, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I could ask you the same thing.
I'm surprised to see you here too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You sure do have a habit of avoiding my questions.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I guess so. It's just that I don't have any particular reason for being here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm just enjoying the scenery.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm just enjoying the scenery.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What is it?
You look a bit confused...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do I? I just remembered that you said the exact same thing the first time we met.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, did I?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you seem a lot different now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyhow, do you know where I can find someone named Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
He's your friend, right?
I saw you two talking earlier and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tsukasa?
Is he a friend of yours too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Not quite. He's a friend of a friend, I guess.
I've been looking everywhere for him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wish I could help, but I have no idea where he went. He's like a storm that blows by and is gone before you know it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, he did seem like the type who can't sit still for long.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I saw his play earlier today. The plot, his performance, everything was just crazy! I had no clue what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe, that sounds about right.
He's like that day in and day out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You know, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I saw you rehearsing earlier and you seemed to be having a ton of fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, yes. Tsukasa, Nene and I were going over some lines for the play...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We used to spend a lot of time doing nothing on the rooftop back in middle school...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I felt some relief when I saw you getting along with people and having fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Who's there...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I wasn't expecting an audience in such a remote location.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An audience?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I was here first, you know.
You got a problem with that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Not at all.
I didn't mean to offend.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Rui Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Kamishiro, huh?
Oh, you're that notorious third year...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, my fame precedes me.
Will you tell me your name?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Well in any case, it would seem fate has brought us together here today. It's nice to meet you, Mizuki Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why'd you ask my name if you already knew it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because I wanted you to tell me yourself of course.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're pretty weird...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I get that often.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, what did you come up here for?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm just enjoying the scenery.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: During the School Festival? Don't have anything better to do?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All you can see from up here is people milling around like ants down below.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're right. But I like the view.
You can see just how lively everything is.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone's enjoying one show or another.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If you like that sort of thing, why aren't you down there with them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I wish I could.
I would if I actually could...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess we're kinda two peas in a pod...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, you're here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki. You're late today. Third period's already started, you know.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Why are you even waiting for me anyway?
It's not like I promised to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know. I've been reading this drama play, you see.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Avoiding my questions again, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, but I was just getting to my answer. This play is about a hero that patiently waits for someone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought by waiting for you, I might be able to understand the mentality of this character a little better.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm? Is this play any good?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, it depends on who you ask...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Isn't that true about everything?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In the case of this play, there's no definite conclusion, so the answer is up to the audience's interpretation.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see. Not like I have anything against stories like that, but why are you reading that sort of stuff? I thought you wanted to do fun shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I do. But in order to do that, I first need to expand my horizons.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Expand your horizons, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is that the real reason you're always up here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I figured you talked to people like me because you were looking for inspiration or something you could use in your shows?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well, you're correct in a sense.
I always find our conversations inspirational.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But to be clear, I draw inspiration from everyone around me, not just you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Well...
If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. To be fair, it's probably not a good thing that my thoughts always revolve around how something can be used in a show.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that, but it's not like you intend to change anytime soon, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course not.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Even if that's the reason you're all alone?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
All alone...
Well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Solitude isn't as bad as people make it out to be.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In fact, it has had certain benefits for me. It's given me plenty of time to see plays and to think over ideas for shows, for example.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It even gave me another lonesome friend on the school rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Solitude has given you a friend?
Isn't that contradictory?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I suppose you're right.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A friend in solitude...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe one day you'll find friends who have more in common with you than just being lonely...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe. God only knows...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
God, huh?
Where's God when you need them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Where indeed...
Well, while we're on the subject...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How would you like to wait until the end of fourth period with me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Why not...?
Not like I have anything else to do...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's really great that you've made new friends. Tsukasa and that girl who was there with you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ugh, to think I'd lose to you like this... I'm definitely the one with better communication skills too...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's not true...
You've made some new friends too, no?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What makes you say that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Call it a director's intuition, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Is that really a thing?
Anyway, it's not like I...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, maybe you're right. I'm just not sure you could call us friends yet...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But yeah, I have met some people...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I knew it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That could be why I can enjoy this view without feeling jealous even though there's still a lot in my life that still isn't great.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems like we both met some good people.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And yet we're killing time up here instead of enjoying the festival, just like we used to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, look. There's a crowd gathering in the courtyard...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The night festival will be starting soon.
I heard there will be dancing and live music.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh. I guess School Festivals in high school can have those.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Sounds like we have company.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh? Who could it be?
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Mizuki, there you are!
I tried calling, but you didn't pick up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And there's Rui! I finally found you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh... It was so embarrassing searching the entire school with this guy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, my apologies. I wasn't aware you were looking for me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad we finally found you too, Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh! Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for earlier.
I actually found Tsukasa right after you left.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So you got to tell him your thoughts about the play? That's great!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. We didn't want you to keep wasting your time looking, but you didn't tell us how we could contact you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I should've thought about that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I just happened to run into them, so we teamed up to look for you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I had no idea you knew each other!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We all just met today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, I didn't know you knew them either!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, anyway... Sorry for all the trouble.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Would you like to come with us to the night festival?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The night festival?
I thought you wanted to go with Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, this is for Kamiyama students only.
She went home a while ago.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Besides, didn't you leave because you were worried about being a third wheel?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What, me? No, you have the wrong idea...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I invited you here, but you ended up all on your own. Let's at least have some fun at the night festival together. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'd love to! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui, you're coming too!
I want the biggest audience I can get!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Audience?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehe. It turns out anyone who wants to take the stage is welcome to, and that's what I intend to do!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is that why you had to leave in such a hurry after the play?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I had to make the necessary preparations for an impromptu show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe. My exquisite voice will soon resonate throughout the entire school!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I also heard that you, Toya and Akito, are decent at singing as well, so I've enlisted them as my backup singers!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Decent...? Gee, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd be more than happy to sing with you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This night festival is the perfect opportunity for me to unveil my newest invention too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's another pointless gadget, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, and one more thing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I brought your class T-shirt too, Mizuki! Here! I'm sure you can find somewhere to get changed now that downstairs isn't as crowded.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But come to think of it... Your class's T-shirt design kinda sucks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What, Akito?! How can you say that?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um, well... It's not really something I'd wear so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not you too, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. We could layer it with something. I mean, we should at least make it look cute if you're gonna wear it♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay. Get changed and let's go to the night festival!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What a strange feeling.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I used to just observe people from the rooftop, but now I have friends of my own to hang out with...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, folks! Let's all go together!
Night festival, here we come!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Follow my lead!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Will you keep it down...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope I have enough time to get my new gadget ready before the performance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't believe I get to be a backup singer for Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh... What a pain...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Who'd have thought the day would come when I'd be part of a lively group like this.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come on, Mizuki! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Coming!
